01What ages does the center accept?+

The Oklahoma childcare listing includes infants (0–11 months), toddlers (12–23 months), preschool children (2–4 years) and school-age children (5 years and older). Ask the center about current age-specific availability.

02What are the regular hours?+

The official listing shows Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM–5:30 PM. The center is listed as closed Saturday and Sunday. Confirm holiday hours directly.

03Does the center operate year-round?+

Yes. Oklahoma Human Services lists this location as year-round care. Confirm any scheduled closures or holidays directly with the center.

04Does the center accept childcare subsidies?+

Yes. Oklahoma Human Services lists the center as accepting subsidies. Eligibility, authorization and family copays should be confirmed with the state and the center.

05What does the 4-star level mean?+

The official Oklahoma Child Care Locator identifies a 4 Star Level Program. This is a state childcare quality designation, not a 4-out-of-5 customer review score.

06How much does childcare cost?+

Tuition, enrollment fees, discounts and payment policies were not independently confirmed. Call or email for current information before making plans.

07How can I ask about available places?+

Call (580) 339-5024 or email princessmartin46@gmail.com to ask the center about openings for your child's age and preferred schedule. Current vacancies were not independently verified.

08Where is CDC 2 located?+

The state lists Loving Hearts & Hands CDC 2 at 1021 E State Hwy 66, Elk City, OK 73644. Confirm entrance and drop-off instructions when planning your first visit.
